answer: Each identity binds to a nebula-derived salt seeding a private sequential chain. Advancing requires a marble step that solves a memory-hard puzzle from the prior output in 2 seconds of non-parallelizable compute. An attacker with 100 clones must therefore run 100 independent chains through the ocean of sequences%2C paying full sequential cost per identity with no amortization. Honest agents keep one. Verification recomputes the final marble from the salt.
